content:
✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: J'accepte cette contribution car c'est une idée de clash intéressante, basée sur des batteries de test et de conditions. 
La solution est à la fois simple et complexe, tout dépend de nos connaissances en programmation. C'est un bon problème qui permet de travailler le débogage lorsqu'uniquement 1 seul test ne fonctionne pas pour un seul cas précis.
Il y aurait en plus beaucoup à faire pour réussir à optimiser le code de par sa taille ou son fonctionnement.
Je ne suis jamais tombé sur un clash of code de ce genre et cela me plairait beaucoup, riee que pour voir les solutions que pourront fournir de très bon joueurs.

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: I have done a similar program in python before, and i think its a cool program to do as a fastest mode challenge

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please move parts (a) and (b) to the Goal section:

(a) from the Output section:
WEAK score (0 to 3)
MEDIUM score (4 to 5)
STRONG score (6 ++ )

(b) the whole Constraints section.

* Please number the rules or add a bullet point (•) before each rule for clarity.

* Please format "WEAK", "MEDIUM", "STRONG", "12" and the five common passwords as {{constants}}.

* Please change "special" to "non-alphanumerical" for clarity.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "password" as a [[variable]].

Output
* Please format "Line 1" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "WEAK", "MEDIUM" and "STRONG" as {{constants}}.

Constraints
* Please add a real constraint:
1 ≤ length of [[password]] ≤ 100

Cases
* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6 where the length of [[password]] is exactly 11, contains more than one non-alphanumerical character, and contains 1234.

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7: Azertyazerty and Qwertyqwerty.

Thanks.

Hello 5DN1L,

Thank you for your feedback.

I have updated the puzzle and applied the requested changes.

Could you please let me know if everything looks good now?

Thanks again.
Everything looks good except that the requested two new pairs of cases don't seem to be added yet.

Hello 5DN1L,

Sorry about that, I thought the new cases had been added correctly.

I've just uploaded the requested Test 5 / Validator 5 and Test 6 / Validator 6.

Please let me know if everything is now in order.

Thanks again.

Thank you.

* Could you please change "Azertyazerty" to "AzErTyaZeRtY" and "Qwertyqwerty" to "qWeRtYQwErTy" so that the case-insensitive aspect can be better tested?

* Please also add one new pair of STRONG password cases: passwor+ADMI123* and admi^PASSWOR123-.

Thanks again.

Hello 5DN1L,

Thank you for your feedback.

Good catch! I've updated the case-insensitive tests and added the new STRONG password cases as requested.

I appreciate your help in improving the puzzle.

Thanks again.
